title: Muse Spark 1.1 costs $1.25 per 1M input tokens and $4.25 per 1M output tokens; Alexandr Wang says coding and agentic tasks were key focuses (Ina Fried/Axios)
summary: Ina Fried / Axios: Muse Spark 1.1 costs $1.25 per 1M input tokens and $4.25 per 1M output tokens; Alexandr Wang says coding and agentic tasks were key focuses — Facebook's parent company on Thursday updated its Muse Spark large language model and followed through on a promise to make it available to developers.
